newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Four South Korean IPOs to start trading Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Four South Korean IPOs to start trading Wednesday.

text.p: Four South Korean initial public offerings (IPOs) will begin trading on Wednesday, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Tuesday.
The four stocks had been initially offered in December.
Woo Bang Housing and Construction Co Ltd will list 3.204 million new shares, which were offered at 12,000 won per share.
First Mutual Savings and Finance Co Ltd will list 1.76 million shares. They had been initially offered at 6,300 won each.
Comtec Systems Co Ltd, a wireless telecommunications system manufacturer, will list 520,000 shares. The initial offer price was set at 40,000 won.
SJM Co Ltd, an auto parts maker, will list 364,000 shares. The IPO took place at 19,000 won per share.
